# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_VWAP_RECLAIM_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Low volatility contraction (ATR compression) precedes expansion; a VWAP reclamation with rising volume and bullish EMA ribbon bias signals a breakout. Entry on the close of the compression bar captures the initial momentum surge before mean reversion, exploiting the transition from chop to trend.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When ATR(5) for three consecutive bars < 0.5 × ATR(20) AND price closes above VWAP AND volume of that bar > 1.5 × average volume of prior 20 bars AND EMA8 > EMA21 (bullish ribbon bias) then enter long at the close.  
**Exit:** Stop at the swing low preceding the compression bar, TP1 at 2R (double the risk from entry to stop), runner trail using Chandelier exit (ATR(22) × 3.0). Regime filters: VIX between 12‑22, time after 10:00 ET to avoid noisy first hour, and only when market is transitioning from chop to trend (inferred from rising ADX > 25).
